payload.summary: PR #450 merged successfully with rebase after 18 CI checks passed and the declared non-deployable validation gate continued without override. All 33 tasks are complete, so no migration is required; architecture provenance was refreshed, submodule sync was a no-op, and the OpenSpec archive is the remaining cleanup action. Staged traffic rollout is not applicable because the approved change declares deployable: false.

decisions.title: Archive after merge
